assumptionsAndDecisions.statement: This plan remediates the gaps from two independent adversarial reviews of the broker-completion build; findings are recorded in R&D Record + Critique Resolution with IDs.
Isolation must be enforced on mode-aware EFFECTIVE trust (adapter-reported > declared > refuse), not the static capability declaration.
Plan must cover all blockers and non-blockers.
All new contracts are new versioned schemas registered in schemas/registry.json with compatibility rows; frozen schemas are never edited in place.
Broker mediation is a HOST-SIDE listener dual-attached to the internal + egress Docker networks (user-dictated); policy and credential refs stay host-side.
Drop capture is optional by default; a worker start degrades observably and fails closed only when the policy requires capture via requireDropCapture.
The mode-aware effective-isolation gate is ENABLED by default and an unknown effective isolation is refused.
Delivery is commit-only on a separate explicit invocation; no push and no merge.

discoveredRequirements.requirement: Enforce isolation on effective, mode-aware trust at the executor seam; never on the static capability declaration.
